snippet.title: R-Type Delta: HD Boosted - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The Bydo are counterattacking! Join the fight with R-Type Delta HD Boosted and drive back the nightmare invasion!    

The invasion arrives on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox SeriesX|S and PS4&PS5 on November 20!

Follow Clear River Games on X for updates: http://www.x.com/clearrivergames
